Havlin was suspended for 3 days for careless riding as he angled his mount left-handed going into the bend when insufficiently clear of KAARANAH, intimidating that runner inwards, which in turn put pressure on SEVENTY and in turn  crowded ALEEN onto MAGICIAN OF RIGA (IRE) which caused Shepherd to check SPIRIT OF JURA for several strides when running out of racing room on the rail.

Levey was suspended for 9 days for improper riding as he had directed his mount right-handed, making contact with ALEEN after Morris had improved into a tight but legitimate gap to his outside, which then resulted in Morris having to take a substantial check following his mount being forced onto and across the heels of KAARANAH (IRE).
